obligations.body: 183002 requires F to be a total single-valued function from source vector carrier to target vector carrier.
183002 requires F(0_A)=0_B.
183002 requires F(u+v)=F(u)+F(v).
183002 requires F(a*v)=a*F(v).
183003 requires BFORM to be a total single-valued binary relation V×V->C.
183003 requires additivity in the first argument.
183003 requires scalar linearity in the first argument.
183003 requires additivity in the second argument.
183003 requires scalar linearity in the second argument.
188100 requires F to satisfy the exact unary-function schema.
188100 requires equal represented outputs to imply equal represented inputs.
188100 requires every target member to have a represented source preimage.
193200 requires exactly both 183002 linearity and 188100 bijection for the same F and carriers.
187600 requires exactly two named vectors to lie in the admitted vector carrier.
187600 requires zero linear combination of the two named vectors to force both coefficients to zero.
187600 requires every admitted vector to have a two-coordinate representation in the named vectors.
187601 requires exactly four named vectors to lie in the admitted vector carrier.
187601 requires zero linear combination of the four named vectors to force all four coefficients to zero.
187601 requires every admitted vector to have a four-coordinate representation in the named vectors.
215000 requires exactly eight named vectors to lie in the admitted vector carrier.
215000 requires zero linear combination of the eight named vectors to force all eight coefficients to zero.
215000 requires every admitted vector to have an eight-coordinate representation in the named vectors.
No orthogonality, norm, signature, canonicality, algebra product, composition algebra, conjugation, triality, reflection, or natural-identity semantics are included.
Relations 183001,183004,183005,183006 and 188101 that share historical files with selected candidates remain outside this module and receive no authority from this qualification.

closure_rule: All 24 obligations must reconstruct from the exact selected relation bodies. Unselected relations in shared files remain outside scope and unqualified.
